name: The Student Lounge
hours: Open Morning to Evening (closed at night from the curfew); movie night every other Thursday.
sight: A sprawling room of mismatched sofas, beanbags and low tables above the cafeteria, with a pull-down screen, two ancient arcade cabinets and a vending machine that sells boosters as well as soda. A corkboard wall is thick with flyers. Someone is always asleep under a jacket; someone is always losing loudly at a card game invented last week.
things: Flop on a sofa and recover between slots
Buy a booster from the vending machine (45 cr, list price) and open it with an audience
Play the home-brew format of the week (currently: one-hero pauper)
Come to movie night and argue about the film
Read the flyer wall for clubs, tutoring and things for sale
Beat the high score on the cabinet 'Pixel Party Panic' (held for six years by 'LIL')
Join the open deck clinic where upper-years tear lists apart for fun
secret: Low-stakes social hub: movie nights (Days 11, 30, 72 relocated, 143), the Fool's Draft (Day 185). The vending machine boosters are a small gamble that sometimes pays; Tomi knows which column was restocked. The six-year high score 'LIL' is not Lilia (she has been here four years) — it is an old Umbra House student, Lil, one of the four sent home; Josie knew her. D27+: Marit's improv troupe notices that '{H}' laughs half a second after everyone else, every time, at the same pitch. Third incident (Day 66, plot timeline, preventable): Tomi is found here by Livvie when she opens up for her cleaning shift, binder open, loupe in hand.
